question: If the letters of the word ACCELERATIONS are arranged in the alphabetical order, then which of the following letters will be in the centre of the arrangement?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

If the letters of the word ACCELERATIONS are arranged in the alphabetical order

A < A < C < C < E < E < **I** < L < N < O < R < S < T

Here, we can see that '**I**' is in the centre of the arrangement.

Hence, **option 1)** is the correct answer.
